name: Sheet
definition: a flat or fitted sheet of woven or knitted fabric laid over the mattress or under the top cover; fitted or flat is an attribute.
notes: Dunelm bed sheets filter; fitted sheet product shown

name: Pillowcase
definition: a removable fabric case that covers a bed pillow.
notes: pillowcases sold standard, Oxford, body pillowcase

name: Duvet cover
definition: a removable fabric bag, closed by buttons, ties or a zip, that encloses a duvet or comforter.
notes: duvet cover is removable case over a duvet insert

name: Valance or dust ruffle
definition: a fabric skirt fitted between mattress and bed base that hides the base and legs.
notes: sold as bed skirts and dust ruffles; vaulted and wrap-around

name: Duvet (insert)
definition: a filled top cover with loose fill in stitched channels or boxes, made to be used inside a removable duvet cover; fill, fill power and tog are attributes.
notes: duvet is a fill-filled insert used inside a removable cover

name: Comforter
definition: a thick filled top cover sewn closed with the fill built in, used without a separate cover.
notes: comforter has two sewn fabric layers, cover built in

name: Quilt
definition: a thinner top cover of two fabric layers with a light batting, held together by visible quilted stitching.
notes: quilt is a multilayer blanket with batting stitched between layers

name: Bedspread or coverlet
definition: a single-layer or lightly lined decorative cover laid over the made bed.
notes: listed as bedspreads and bed throws

name: Featherbed
definition: a thick feather- or down-filled pad laid on top of the mattress to sleep on.
notes: sold as a goose feather bed mattress topper; feather-filled

name: Blanket or throw
definition: a woven, knitted or fleece cover without fill, for a bed or a sofa; size, weight (weighted blankets, unless sold to treat a stated condition) and setting are attributes.
notes: blankets and throws sold as one category

name: Electric blanket (heated throw)
definition: a blanket or throw with built-in electric heating wires and a controller, laid on or under the sleeper or used on a sofa.
notes: electric blankets (fitted) and heated throws sold as separate groups

name: Bed pillow
definition: a stuffed pillow made to support the head in bed; fill, firmness and orthopaedic shaping are attributes.
notes: pillows sold as bedding category

name: Travel pillow
definition: a pillow, often U-shaped or inflatable, made to support the head and neck while sitting in transit.
notes: molded foam and inflatable wedge travel pillows

name: Positioning cushion
definition: a shaped foam or inflatable cushion made to hold the body in a chosen position (wedges and ramps); fill is an attribute.
notes: pregnancy support wedge pillow; side-sleeping positioning

name: Mattress protector
definition: a thin, often waterproof cover fitted over or around the mattress to guard it against spills and wear.
notes: protectors guard against liquids and dust; some waterproof

name: Mattress pad
definition: a thin quilted or padded layer fitted over the mattress for light extra comfort.
notes: mattress pads listed beside protectors in one shop

name: Mattress topper
definition: a thicker removable layer of foam, latex, fibre or down laid on the mattress to change its feel.
notes: Airflow Mattress Topper listed; toppers sold in Mattress Toppers category

name: Knotted-pile rug
definition: a rug or carpet whose pile is formed by knots tied around the warps, by hand or machine.
notes: hand-knotted rugs; pile tied round warps

name: Flatweave rug
definition: a rug woven without pile, the pattern made by the weft (kilim, soumak, dhurrie constructions).
notes: kilim, dhurrie, soumak flatweaves; no knots or pile

name: Woven pile rug or carpet
definition: a rug or carpet whose pile is woven in with the backing on a loom (Wilton, Axminster constructions).
notes: Axminster and Wilton machine-woven pile named

name: Tufted rug or carpet
definition: a rug or carpet whose pile yarn is punched through a pre-made backing and fixed with adhesive, by hand gun or machine.
notes: hand-tufted rugs named as own construction

name: Hooked rug
definition: a rug made by pulling loops of yarn or fabric strips through a woven backing with a hook.
notes: hand-hooked rugs named as own construction

name: Felt rug or carpet
definition: a rug or carpet of matted fibre, made by felting rather than weaving.
notes: felt ball wool rug; felted wool rugs by Apadana on 1stdibs

name: Needlepunched carpet
definition: a carpet or carpet tile whose fibres are interlocked by barbed needles into a dense non-woven sheet.
notes: needlefelt carpet in sheet and tile; commercial

name: Hide rug
definition: a rug that is a tanned animal hide with its hair, or a patchwork of hides (cowhide, sheepskin).
notes: sold as sheepskin and cowhide rugs

name: Rag rug
definition: a rug braided, woven or hooked from strips of reused cloth.
notes: rag rugs plaited, punched needle or woven; museum page

name: Door mat
definition: a hard-wearing mat laid at a door to wipe shoes and catch dirt.
notes: door mats sold as own category

name: Bath mat
definition: an absorbent mat laid beside a bath or shower to stand on with wet feet.
notes: bath mat listed with towels

name: Kitchen mat
definition: a mat or runner laid in front of a kitchen counter or sink to stand on while working.
notes: kitchen mats and anti-fatigue mats for standing

name: Chair mat
definition: a mat laid under a desk chair to protect the floor and let castors roll.
notes: clear chair mat protects floor from chair wheels; hard-floor and carpet versions

name: Meditation mat
definition: a flat padded mat laid on the floor under a meditation cushion or to sit on for meditation.
notes: zabuton described as meditation mat under memory foam zafu collection

name: Curtain
definition: a panel of fabric hung from a pole or track to cover a window or door, lined or unlined.
notes: eyelet, pencil pleat, blackout, thermal curtains

name: Sheer, voile or net curtain
definition: a curtain of light translucent fabric that filters light and gives daytime privacy.
notes: voile and net curtains category of voile panels

name: Shower curtain
definition: a water-resistant curtain hung from a rail to close a shower or bath opening.
notes: fabric shower curtains category

name: Studio backdrop
definition: a large cloth or paper-like textile sheet hung or stretched behind a subject in a photo or video studio.
notes: muslin photography backdrops sold; sweep and floor options

name: Roller blind
definition: a single panel of fabric that rolls up onto a tube at the head of the window.
notes: roller: fabric on roller raised by chain or spring

name: Roman blind
definition: a fabric blind that folds up into horizontal pleats as it is raised by cords.
notes: roman: fabric folds into pleats when raised

name: Venetian blind
definition: a blind of horizontal slats that tilt and lift on cords or tapes.
notes: venetian: horizontal tilting slats

name: Vertical blind
definition: a blind of vertical vanes hung from a track that rotate and draw to one side.
notes: vertical: vanes slide on a track

name: Pleated blind
definition: a blind of crisply pleated fabric that concertinas up or down.
notes: pleated: fabric or paper folded accordion style

name: Cellular shade
definition: a pleated blind of two or more fabric layers forming insulating cells (honeycomb).
notes: cellular or honeycomb: two-layer cells; MMB groups with pleated

name: Panel blind
definition: wide flat fabric panels that slide side to side on a multi-channel track.
notes: panel blinds run on a track; Japanese-style; Wikipedia only

name: Scatter cushion
definition: a loose stuffed decorative cushion for a sofa, chair or bed.
notes: scatter cushions and scatter covers sold; filled cover and inner

name: Chair pad (seat pad)
definition: a thin cushion, usually with ties or a non-slip back, made to lie on the seat of a chair.
notes: IKEA chair pads and seat cushions group; Dunelm seat pads

name: Floor cushion [zabuton]
definition: a large flat cushion with no frame, made to sit on at floor level.
notes: floor cushions for indoor and outdoor use

name: Meditation cushion
definition: a firm cushion with no frame, round or crescent, made to sit on for meditation (zafu).
notes: zafu round cushions; memory foam Cloud and Mountain Seat

name: Cushion cover
definition: a removable fabric case for a cushion, sold without or with the insert.
notes: cushion covers sold separately from inserts

name: Sofa cover
definition: a removable fabric cover (slipcover, throw-over or stretch cover) for a sofa, also when made to fit one model (the model in `fits`).
notes: sofa covers for 2- to 5-seat, corner and sofa-bed

name: Chair cover
definition: a removable fabric cover for a chair, dining and event chairs included, also when made to fit one model.
notes: armchair covers and wing chair slipcover

name: Tablecloth
definition: a cloth laid over a table top to protect and dress it.
notes: tablecloths sold with runners

name: Table runner
definition: a long narrow cloth laid along the centre of a table.
notes: table runners sold with tablecloths

name: Placemat (textile)
definition: a fabric mat laid under one place setting; hard placemats are B5.
notes: IKEA place mats and coasters category

name: Cloth napkin
definition: a square of fabric for wiping hands and mouth at table.
notes: napkins category

name: Kitchen towel or tea towel
definition: a cloth for drying dishes and hands in the kitchen.
notes: kitchen towels category uses tea towel interchangeably

name: Bath sheet
definition: the largest bath towel, big enough to wrap the whole body.
notes: bath sheet 35x60 to 40x70 in

name: Bath towel
definition: a large absorbent towel for drying the body after bathing.
notes: bath towel 27x52 to 30x58 in

name: Hand towel
definition: a mid-size towel for drying hands and face.
notes: hand towel 16x28 to 18x30 in

name: Washcloth
definition: a small square towel (face cloth, flannel) for washing the face and body.
notes: washcloth also called face towel or flannel

name: Beach towel
definition: a large towel made to lie on at the beach or pool and dry off.
notes: striped beach towels sold

name: Flat-woven towel [peshtemal, hammam towel]
definition: a thin flat-woven towel without terry loops, light and quick-drying.
notes: peshtemal: thin flat-woven Turkish towel, no loop pile

name: Swaddling cloth
definition: a square of soft fabric made to wrap a baby snugly.
notes: muslin swaddle blankets 46-47 in square

name: Carry cloth [furoshiki]
definition: a square cloth made to wrap and carry goods or gifts by knotting its corners.
notes: furoshiki wrapping cloth collection, 24 products

name: Curtain pole
definition: a rod fixed above a window or door from which curtains hang on rings or by their heading.
notes: fixed, extendable and eyelet curtain poles

name: Curtain track or rail
definition: a fixed track with runners or gliders along which curtains are drawn.
notes: curtain track systems, single/double, wall or ceiling

name: Curtain rings and hooks
definition: rings, hooks, gliders and clips that attach a curtain heading to its pole or track.
notes: curtain rings, hooks, tieback hooks sold as fixtures

name: Rug pad or underlay
definition: a pad laid under a rug or carpet to stop slipping, cushion it and protect the floor.
notes: anti-slip underlays and rug pads sold
